title: Fixed Pier Floor and Wall Flue Room Cutaway
description: One newly authored complete static hypocaust-inspired room section. A continuous low foundation supports a grid of full short masonry piers under one thick L-section retained room floor. The deliberately removed front-right floor area exposes the real underfloor chamber and column-supported floor datum. A separate whole low arched fire corridor passes through a genuine opening in the lower front wall into that chamber. One integral rear wall contains three full hollow vertical channels with actual low front inlets below the floor and open upper ends; the central channel also has an explicit above-floor inspection section. A retained tall side wall and short lower side return define the room boundary. Unlike an open stilt granary, the void is enclosed below an occupied floor with separate side fire entry and wall risers; unlike the rising pottery kiln, the fire chamber is below a pier-supported upper room rather than within a rising loading vault. All visible geometry newly authored, no existing kiln, granary or room mesh imported. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, full ground foundation and horizontally centred bounds. One architectural module zero scenes. Empty historical-style artistic cutaway only, not a reconstruction or building proposal. No fire, smoke, fuel, hot gases, heating performance, airflow, flue sizing, occupancy, structural load, fire resistance, manufacture, construction or engineering safety capability. No rig, animation or interaction made or verified.
